article.title: The good news is…
article.excerpt: In 2005, the two state airlines – Mexicana and Aeroméxico – were hived off for privatisation and permits were granted for five new low-cost carriers. The following year, the number of air passengers grew by almost 12 per cent, more than in all the previous five years combined. Flights from Mexico City to Cancún now can be had for less than $100.
